therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: lymphocyte sequestration in lymphoid organs reducing CNS infiltration
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: mean number of gadolinium-enhanced T1-weighted lesions at month 6

results.effect_size: Gd-enhanced T1 lesions at month 6: placebo 2.3, FTY720 1.25 mg 1.4, FTY720 5.0 mg 0.4
results.target_engagement_evidence: Mean trough blood concentrations at steady state: 7.64 ng/mL (1.25 mg) and 30.5 ng/mL (5.0 mg) at month 3; 7.38 ng/mL and 28.9 ng/mL at month 6
biomarker_changes: Mean trough FTY720 blood concentration at month 3: 7.64 ng/mL (1.25 mg/day), 30.5 ng/mL (5.0 mg/day)
Mean trough FTY720 blood concentration at month 6: 7.38 ng/mL (1.25 mg/day), 28.9 ng/mL (5.0 mg/day)
Change from baseline in T2 lesion volume at month 6: +146.15 mm³ (placebo), -115.81 mm³ (1.25 mg), -607.97 mm³ (5.0 mg)
Change from baseline in T2 lesion volume at month 60: -621.82 mm³ (placebo), -204.09 mm³ (1.25 mg), -1429.98 mm³ (5.0 mg)
subgroup_findings: At month 6, percentage free of Gd-enhanced T1 lesions: 47.0% placebo vs 76.7% (1.25 mg) vs 78.2% (5.0 mg)
At month 6, percentage free of both Gd-T1 and new T2 lesions: 47.5% placebo vs 77.0% (1.25 mg) vs 80.7% (5.0 mg)
KM estimate of relapse-free patients at 200 days: 0.69 placebo vs 0.86 (1.25 mg) vs 0.86 (5.0 mg)
KM estimate of relapse-free patients at 2600 days: 0.44 placebo vs 0.55 (1.25 mg) vs 0.66 (5.0 mg)
Mean Gd-enhanced T1 lesions at month 12 (extension, after placebo patients switched): 0.4 (placebo/switched), 1.0 (1.25 mg), 0.2 (5.0 mg)
safety_signals: Bradycardia observed as serious AE in 3/94 patients on FTY720 5.0 mg vs 1/93 on placebo
AV block first degree (serious) in 1/94 on FTY720 1.25 mg
Cardiac events (bradycardia, extrasystoles, palpitations, ventricular extrasystoles) more frequent in FTY720 5.0 mg arm

context.duration: 6-month core phase with extension up to approximately 80 months (up to 2801 days)
